Brissen

Overview

Brissen is a knight allied with the Woodsfolk who describes his life as service to good. He offers to accompany Zak after hearing of him from Grey Leaf. His methods are less gentle than his ideals sound: he explains how the Woodsfolk intimidate witnesses who might recognise him in the city. [1, 2, 3]

Recruitment and farewell

Brissen is alive when Zak meets him, despite rumours in the city. Grey Leaf has told him about Zak, and he offers to serve the good cause alongside him. His professed ideals do not forbid stealth or rough methods; he says that war against evil requires practical means. Duties defending the Woodsfolk against the Black Clan can delay his departure. After being recognised, he can hide with the Green Clan. He explains that Grey Leaf keeps his presence secret by threatening witnesses with the burning or collapse of their property until they dismiss the sighting as a drunken dream. His farewell again dismisses rumours of his death. [1, 2, 4, 3, 5, 6, 7]
